races.name: Gieves And Hawkes Supports The YCC Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: According To Mark
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with recent course and distance form advantage, well-suited to tracking the pace from an ideal position.
runners_data.comment: Went close at Redcar on reappearance and the winner has boosted the form since
runners_data.spotlight: Eye-catcher in sole 2yo start; went very close at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) on reappearance and the winner boosted that form by seeming to run well in the Chester Vase since; strong contender.

runners_data.name: Alma Latina
runners_data.note: Class prominent runner from top connections, bred to stay this trip but may need to be more aggressive tactically than in previous starts.
runners_data.comment: Clear promise in a couple of 1m2f events, close second at Salisbury latest; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a 1m2f Listed winner for her connections; has duly shown clear promise in two fillies' novice events over this trip, close second at Salisbury (good) latest; still open to progress and warrants respect.

runners_data.name: Maid On The Shelf
runners_data.note: Prominent type bringing poor form and facing a significant class rise, the 71-day absence raises questions about readiness.
runners_data.comment: Comfortably held in 8.5f AW contest at Wolverhampton
runners_data.spotlight: Brings easily the worst form, having been comfortably held in 8.5f AW contest at Wolverhampton ten weeks ago; best watched unless the market suggests she's likely to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Fozzie
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner showing improvement since gelding, but pedigree and previous efforts suggest stamina may be stretched at this trip.
runners_data.comment: One of the main form contenders but pedigree raises a stamina doubt over new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown improvement with a couple of second-place finishes this term since being gelded, latest at Redcar (1m, good); one of the form contenders but pedigree raises a stamina doubt upped further in trip.

races.paceDynamic: Fozzie looks the lone pace angle as the confirmed front runner, with According To Mark, Alma Latina, and Maid On The Shelf all showing prominent tendencies but likely to settle just behind. With only four runners and Fozzie uncontested on the lead, he can dictate a comfortable gallop that may not expose stamina limitations over this 1m2f trip. The lack of genuine hold-up horses means the pace will be honest but not punishing, creating a tactical race where positioning matters more than explosive finishing kicks. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track Fozzie and have the tactical speed to respond when the pace lifts approaching the home turn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Fozzie Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Fozzie gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: His recent gelding operation has sparked improvement and he can use the tactical advantage of dictating terms to see off late challengers. The prominent horses behind may struggle to reel him in if he keeps finding more under pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If According To Mark and Alma Latina track Fozzie closely and engage him turning for home
scenarios.body: The superior class and recent form of these two fillies tells as they overwhelm Fozzie in the final furlong. Both have shown they stay this trip well and their RPR ratings suggest they have more to offer.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: According To Mark Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the Bethell gelding settles perfectly and produces his Redcar form
scenarios.body: His eye-catching debut and close second at Redcar over this exact trip gives him a fitness edge after a more recent run than his main rivals. Edward Bethell's string is in good form and Rodriguez knows the horse well.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Maid Intervention
scenarios.trigger: If Maid On The Shelf has been working much better at home and the market support materializes
scenarios.body: The 71-day break may have allowed Charlie Johnston to address her previous shortcomings and the step up in trip could unlock improvement. Her weak form makes this unlikely but stranger things have happened in small fields.

watchPoints.text: Fozzie's early fractions - if he goes too fast early he'll be vulnerable but too slow and the prominent horses will have too much left
According To Mark's settling - Rodriguez needs to get a good position without getting into an early battle with the other prominent runners
Market support for Maid On The Shelf - any meaningful money would suggest the Johnston team expects significant improvement
Alma Latina's tactical approach - Crouch may need to be more positive than usual given the lack of pace pressure
How quickly the field bunches turning for home - will indicate whether Fozzie has done enough to set up a genuine staying test

runners_data.name: Bravo Zulu
runners_data.note: Prominent runner better over 7f-8f but showed improved 6f form when runner-up at Redcar last week

runners_data.name: The Good Biscuit

runners_data.comment: Form at Pontefract features two wins in 2025 and a close second this spring

runners_data.name: Emperor Caradoc
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner still in good form despite career-high mark, consistent Pontefract performer
runners_data.comment: Remains in form; Pontefract record is largely consistent; solid contender
runners_data.spotlight: Still on career-high mark but latest effort (when bidding for 6f double) suggests he remains in form, and his Pontefract record is largely consistent; solid contender.

runners_data.name: Rock Opera
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in decent form with two recent placed efforts, 7lb below last winning mark
runners_data.comment: On a two-year losing spell but is in form and remains 7lb below last winning mark
runners_data.spotlight: In reasonably good form having made the frame in last two starts, rallying both times; on a two-year losing spell but remain 7lb below last winning mark; enters calculations.

runners_data.name: Mr Cool
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who needs return to 6f after recent 7f campaigns, claims 3lbs and well-treated
runners_data.comment: Campaigned over 7f of late; return to 6f looks ideal and he's on a very attractive mark

runners_data.name: Alpha Capture
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning to 6f after longer trips this season, 45 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Useful over 6f early in career but isn't crying out for the return to this trip

runners_data.name: Maris Angel
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 158-day break, 12lb higher than last turf attempt
runners_data.comment: Good spell on AW leaves her 12lb higher than last turf attempt; back from layoff
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since a respectable effort on Boxing Day when bidding for a Wolverhampton AW five-timer; only 1-9 on turf and is 12lb higher than last attempt in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Irish Nectar
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor turf record, encouragingly ran well last time on all-weather
runners_data.comment: Chance may depend on the weather's actions; all wins on soft ground
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 0-6, mostly on AW, for current yard; ran encouragingly last time but chance back on turf may depend on the weather's actions; has done his winning on soft ground.

runners_data.name: Dashing Dick
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in poor form this season, claims 5lbs but hasn't won away from Newmarket since 2022
runners_data.comment: Has a big doubt over current form and is ideally suited by Newmarket
runners_data.spotlight: Ended last season with a success but has contrastingly started this campaign in poor form; hasn't won away from Newmarket since 2022; others preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Emperor Caradoc will dictate terms from the front with Bravo Zulu, Mr Cool and Dashing Dick providing some company in the early stages. The pace should be genuine but not frantic over this 6f trip, allowing the front rank to maintain their position without severe pressure. A large contingent of hold-up horses including Aberama Gold, The Good Biscuit, Rock Opera, Alpha Capture, Maris Angel and Irish Nectar will be looking to close from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position themselves within striking distance early and have the tactical speed to respond when the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If Emperor Caradoc sets a steady but sustainable gallop without being hassled early
scenarios.body: The front rank maintains their advantage as the hold-up brigade struggle to make significant inroads in the final furlong. Emperor Caradoc and Bravo Zulu can use their forward positions to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes dawdling with Emperor Caradoc unchallenged through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole allowing the best finishers to sweep past tiring leaders. The Good Biscuit and Aberama Gold can utilise their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strike
scenarios.trigger: If genuine early fractions are set but the front rank comes under pressure from the 3f marker
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in fourth to sixth place can slip through as leaders tire and closers find insufficient time. Mr Cool drops back to his optimum trip while Rock Opera continues his consistent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Emperor Caradoc goes too fast early under pressure from multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The entire front rank stops badly in the final furlong allowing a strong closer to pick up the pieces. Maris Angel returns from a long break with fresh legs to capitalise on the carnage.

watchPoints.text: Emperor Caradoc's early fractions will determine if front-runners survive or get swallowed up late
Maris Angel's fitness after 158 days off could be crucial if the pace collapses
The Good Biscuit's response to first-time cheekpieces after disappointing last start
Mr Cool's ability to adapt back to 6f after string of 7f efforts
Bravo Zulu's stamina reserves dropping back from 7f having shown improved speed at Redcar

runners_data.name: Saucy Jane

runners_data.comment: Guesswork is involved as regards another change of surface

runners_data.name: Rogue Temptation

runners_data.name: Storm Esme
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with proven course form but hasn't fired in two spring starts in higher grades
runners_data.comment: Spring defeats came in higher grades; may post a bigger effort at this level
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 2-3 last year suggested she could prove a progressive type this term; that hasn't hitherto materialised but her two spring defeats came in higher grades; may be capable of a bigger effort at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Storm Esme and D Flawless will break fast and engage in early pace, with both fillies preferring to race prominently from the gates. The honest early gallop will stretch the field early over this sharp 6f at Pontefract, with Egotistical, Zarinca, Saucy Jane and Rogue Temptation tracking the leaders in the second rank. With only 8 runners and two committed front-runners, the pace will be searching but not suicidal, creating a race where prominent racers and those with tactical speed will have the edge over pure hold-up horses. This race shape strongly favours prominent/tracking horses who can position close enough to strike in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Esme and D Flawless engage in a sustained pace battle through the first 4f
scenarios.body: The early leaders will soften each other up, allowing the prominent racers sitting in behind to sweep past in the final furlong. Egotistical and Zarinca are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their proven tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Esme breaks cleanest and establishes a clear lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The Easterby filly can dictate terms and kick clear when it matters, using her proven course form to advantage. D Flawless may track and challenge but Storm Esme's superior turf record gives her the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses with both leaders going too fast too early
scenarios.body: Diamont Katie can use her hold-up style to devastating effect, sweeping wide in the final 2f as others tire. Ruby Red Gove also benefits from a truly-run race where her closing kick becomes effective.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate with no sustained duel developing
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with form can win, making class the deciding factor. Multiple horses remain in contention turning for home in what becomes a cavalry charge.

watchPoints.text: Storm Esme breaks alertly and gets an easy lead as D Flawless misses the break or settles behind
D Flawless and Storm Esme set unsustainable fractions through the first 3f creating a pace collapse
Egotistical travels strongly in behind the leaders approaching the 2f pole for the Varian team
Diamont Katie gets trapped on the rail behind the pace-setting duo with nowhere to go
The 5lb claimer Jack Nicholls keeps Diamont Katie covered up longer than usual in the early stages

runners_data.spotlight: On a handy mark and may be back in better form with Thirsk reappearance under his belt; however, he's on two-year losing spell and record suggests he'll be more interesting when returned to Ayr.

runners_data.spotlight: Kept to a track that suits as his form at Pontefract features wins in 2024/2025 and a resurgent effort (close third) in latest start; faces some unexposed types among his younger rivals but holds a solid chance.

races.paceDynamic: Pol Roger is the sole confirmed front-runner and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate a steady, sustainable gallop through the early stages at this stamina-testing trip. With seven hold-up horses behind him, the pace will be honest but not frantic, building gradually through the middle sections before intensifying from the home turn. The lack of pace pressure means Pol Roger can conserve energy early, while the massed ranks of hold-up performers will create a cavalry charge finish as they all try to deliver their challenges simultaneously. This tactical setup strongly favours horses with genuine stamina who can sustain their finishing kick, particularly those drawn to get clear runs in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pol Roger Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Pol Roger maintains his advantage turning for home and the hold-up brigade can't get to him in time.
scenarios.body: The leader's energy conservation pays dividends as he kicks clear when the chasers are still organising their challenges, with only the strongest stayers able to reel him in late. Pol Roger's front-running style becomes the winning move rather than a liability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get ideal splits and can unleash sustained finishing kicks from the two-furlong pole.
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the closers pay off as they swarm past a tiring Pol Roger, with the strongest finisher and best-positioned horse prevailing in a blanket finish. Superior stamina and race positioning determine the winner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pontefract Specialist Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Distinction's course form and recent resurgence combine with his ideal positioning off the steady pace.
scenarios.body: The eight-year-old's intimate knowledge of Pontefract's unique configuration allows him to find the perfect position throughout before timing his challenge to perfection. His proven course ability trumps younger legs in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble Finish
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems and crowding in the straight prevent several runners from delivering their optimal challenges.
scenarios.body: The bunching effect of seven hold-up horses creates interference and blocked runs, allowing a horse who gets first run or finds daylight early to steal a march. Luck in running becomes more important than raw ability.

watchPoints.text: Pol Roger's early fractions will determine everything - if he goes too fast early he'll stop dramatically, if too slow he'll be swamped by superior finishing speed.
Traffic problems are inevitable with seven hold-up horses converging - watch for Finlaggan and Holly Mist getting clean passages as the best finishers need clear runs.
Distinction's headgear change and course knowledge could be decisive if the pace sets up right for his sustained challenge.
David O'Meara has both Finlaggan and Thequietman declared - watch market moves and jockey instructions to determine stable confidence.
The 1m2f trip at Pontefract rewards stamina over speed - any horse showing early pace may struggle to last home in this staying test.

races.paceDynamic: Queen Sana will take this race up from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge her early. Ice Cold Alex, Dolos Dream, Believeinmenow and Quantum Power are all prominent racers who may press but none are natural gate-to-wire types. This creates a controlled tempo with Queen Sana able to dictate fractions without extreme pressure, while the hold-up horses Goldenstateofmind and Liverpool Star will need the pace to develop. The sustainable pace and single leader scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to Queen Sana.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Queen Sana gets an uncontested lead and the prominent horses don't apply serious pressure
scenarios.body: Queen Sana will dictate comfortable fractions and prove hard to peg back, while any prominent racer tracking her closely will benefit from the perfect trip. This tactical setup gives the early positioned horses a decisive advantage over those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If Ice Cold Alex, Quantum Power or Dolos Dream decide to press Queen Sana from the gates
scenarios.body: The increased pace will stretch the field and create opportunities for horses with turn of foot, though still favouring those positioned handy. The tempo lift helps prominent racers with finishing kick while compromising pure front runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Queen Sana goes too slowly early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Goldenstateofmind and Liverpool Star can utilise their closing kicks effectively. However, this requires the leaders to completely mess up the fractions which seems unlikely given Queen Sana's consistency.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners decide to challenge Queen Sana simultaneously from early
scenarios.body: A genuine speed battle will unfold that suits horses with proven stamina at the trip and those coming from off the pace. The early burnout creates opportunities for patient rides and strong finishers.

watchPoints.text: Queen Sana's early position will determine the entire race shape - if she gets a soft lead the hold-up horses are in serious trouble
Quantum Power's settling ability early on after doing too much at Newmarket - needs to track rather than challenge immediately
Liverpool Star wearing first-time cheekpieces which could change his racing style from hold-up to more forward
Dolos Dream's fitness after 158 days off despite solid work reports - any signs of rustiness will be costly in a sprint
The prominent quartet of Ice Cold Alex, Believeinmenow, Dolos Dream and Quantum Power - if they all press Queen Sana it changes everything
